cooked: The fixed one-sigop charge needs a cost comparison against ordinary CHECKSIG, since this path also recovers a point and reconstructs the leaf commitment. I’d benchmark worst-case validation cost and say explicitly whether Merkle hashing is covered by the same budget; otherwise the proposed charge is hard to assess for DoS resistance.
